MOD_CONST = 1000000007

group_vectors = [[] for _ in range(9)]
popcount_array = [0] * (1 << 9)
prob_p = [0] * 9
prob_a = [0] * 9

# Read probabilities for each step
prob_inputs = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n_size)]

for idx_i in range(1 << n_size):
    popcount_array[idx_i] = bin(idx_i).count('1')
    group_vectors[popcount_array[idx_i]].append(idx_i)

dp_map = [dict() for _ in range(n_size + 1)]
dp_map[0][1] = 1

for idx_i in range(n_size):
    # Read probabilities for current step
    for idx_j in range(n_size):
        prob_p[idx_j] = prob_inputs[idx_i][idx_j]
        prob_p[idx_j] = prob_p[idx_j] * 570000004 % MOD_CONST  # modular inverse of 1000000000 mod MOD_CONST

    for state, value in list(dp_map[idx_i].items()):
        for k in range(n_size):
            prob_a[k] = 0
        for m in group_vectors[idx_i]:
            if ((state >> popcount_array[m]) & 1) != 0:
                for j in range(n_size):
                    if ((m >> j) & 1) == 0:
                        prob_a[j] |= (1 << popcount_array[m | (1 << j)])
        for msk in range(1 << n_size):
            val_X = 1
            val_M = 0
            for j in range(n_size):
                if ((msk >> j) & 1) != 0:
                    val_M |= prob_a[j]
                    val_X = (val_X * prob_p[j]) % MOD_CONST
                else:
                    val_X = (val_X * (MOD_CONST + 1 - prob_p[j]) ) % MOD_CONST
            dp_map[idx_i + 1][val_M] = (dp_map[idx_i + 1].get(val_M, 0) + value * val_X) % MOD_CONST

print(dp_map[n_size].get(1, 0))
